blocks.text:
## Buenos Aires, Salta and Iguazu in one trip

Buenos Aires welcomes you with European architecture, broad avenues, neighbourhoods with distinct characters and evening tango. Salta reveals another side of the country: colonial towns, wineries, high-altitude roads and Andean landscapes. At Iguazu, nature takes centre stage: tropical jungle, the roar of water and dozens of cascades viewed from different levels and banks.
